question: Who had established the 'Prarthana Samaj'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atmaram Pandurang**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atmaram Pandurang** established the 'Prarthana Samaj'.
 
• Prarthana Samaj was founded in 1867 in Bombay (now Mumbai).
 
• The movement aimed at reforming the social customs and religious practices of the Hindu community.
 
• It was influenced by the Brahmo Samaj and emphasized monotheism and social reforms such as widow remarriage, women's education, and abolition of caste discrimination.
 
• Atmaram Pandurang was a prominent social reformer and was instrumental in the spread of rational and progressive ideas in the society of that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Prarthana Samaj was part of a larger socio-religious reform movement in India during the 19th century.
 
• It worked towards creating a society based on the values of human dignity, social justice, and equality.
 
• The movement also sought to de-emphasize ritualism and priestly dominance in Hindu religion.
 
• Other notable leaders of the Prarthana Samaj included Mahadev Govind Ranade and R.G. Bhandarkar.
